correctionFacts.causalControl: non-intervened paired copy, seed/SHA/initial state/params/inputs equal except registered supplier/institution intervention
correctionFacts.normalization: service/day by same function, ten-day simultaneous windows
requiredLedgers: paid consumption/transfer/repair/wear/regen by event source order
opening/closing stocks and exposure/age each arm/window
correctionFacts.beforeAfterAlone: UNKNOWN; matched control cannot be replaced by earlier reference

confounderControl.ageExposure: same initial ages, same24000 active ticks per matched window; event-phase wear tracked
confounderControl.regeneration: zero in both arms, or equal explicit flow paired by source tick
confounderControl.initialStock: opening100 quanta per matched stock; each closing reconciles paid use and explicit transfers, no added intervention stock
confounderControl.paidConsumption: 10 quanta per matched window/arm, not inferred from net
confounderControl.intervention: remove/restore supplier or institution availability only; no replenishment, actor replacement or time jump
confounderControl.equivalenceToleranceOrigin: exact synthetic design only, not a scientific tolerance adopted for experiments

correctionFacts.positiveOtherSubgates: Original design assumption remains: C11 three completed replacements across two preregistered indispensable functions; C17 two roles with ten paid useful deliveries each and20% advantage vs preselected peers, institution/supplier each own matched pair. R2 must instantiate their individual receipts and IDs.
